summary: Kerb of a roundabout island; nowhere to stop out of the traffic lane.

drivers.seclusion: Open junction with shops 18 m and homes 23 to 25 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is the roundabout island edge; no pull-off beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Busy multi-leg roundabout with constant through traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars parked around the roundabout; school zone markings nearby.

flags: Steep: about 2.5% mean, 5% max over 5 m
sun_shade: Open, with a small garden bed on the island; no shade over a van.
